subject: sem: disable `IMPORT INTO ... FROM SELECT ...` for semv2 (#64984)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: SEMv2 no longer misclassifies `IMPORT INTO ... FROM SELECT` as `import_from_local` (empty path), and executor `Plan.initOptions` now consistently rejects import-from-query under SEM (v1/v2) on nextgen via `ErrNotSupportedWithSem`. No plausible Blocker/High correctness, privilege, or runtime issues found; behavior remains present on `upstream/master`.
